Number Activation State are reports with end user numbers that had a change in their activation status. Those would be usually numbers that become deactivated, however sometimes they would also have information about temporary suspensions or re-activations.

Number state information is provided by our suppliers. To access this information, your business and traffic must be analyzed and approved. This process ensures compliance with regulations. Please contact your Account Manager to request access.
